verdict.rationale: Adyen documents building against named commerce protocols, ACP and UCP. It covers full checkout flows, protocol tokens and UCP session envelopes, and publishes OpenAPI definitions on GitHub that can be loaded into Swagger tooling. However, nothing shows these schemas cover the agentic or protocol APIs specifically, and the docs-hosted OpenAPI probe paths returned 404. Missing for 10: explicit protocol/schema versioning, a published schema tied to the agentic ACP/UCP endpoints, conformance or validation tooling, and independent corroboration.
